denial_summary_plain: Your insurance plan, Univera PPO Plus, denied payment for your breast biopsy on 03/04/2026. They stated the service was not medically necessary. You can work with your care team to appeal this decision.

A written statement from your clinician explaining the need for the service

letter.body:
[TODAY'S DATE]

To: Univera PPO Plus Appeals Department

Re: Request to reconsider a denied service
Member: Sarah Demo    Member ID: [MEMBER ID]
Claim / reference number: DEMO-0001
Date of denial: 03/04/2026
Service denied: CPT 19083 (ultrasound-guided breast biopsy)

To whom it may concern,

I am writing to ask for a review of the decision described above. The notice gave this reason: "the service was not medically necessary".

I am asking the plan to reconsider this decision. A statement from my clinician about this service is below.

[CLINICIAN'S STATEMENT - to be written by your care team]

Please send me the written result of this review, and tell me if you need anything else from me to complete it.

Sincerely,
Sarah Demo

(Draft for review with my care team or the hospital billing office before sending.)

next_steps: Confirm with your plan what the appeal deadline is, as it was not stated in your denial letter
Confirm with your care team if they can provide the needed medical records
Confirm with the hospital billing office if they can help you submit the appeal

steps.action: Hid private details before the AI read the letter
steps.why: Names, member IDs, phone numbers and similar details shouldn't be sent to the AI. It only sees placeholders like [NAME_1]; the real values are put back afterwards, on our side.
steps.result: Replaced 3 private details (1 claim, 1 member id, 1 name).

steps.why: To pull out only the facts the letter actually states, so the draft uses your real details and nothing is guessed.
steps.result: Found: the reason, the denied service, the denial date, the claim number, the plan name, documents the plan asked for. Not stated in the letter: an appeal deadline.
steps.who: The AI read it; code then removed any value that doesn't appear word for word in the letter

steps.action: Compared the letter with your case
steps.why: A mismatch can mean the wrong code was billed or the letter is for a different plan. This only compares facts; it never judges whether the denial is right.
steps.result: No mismatches found: the denied code and plan match your case.

steps.action: Built the letter from a fixed template
steps.why: A fixed template means the letter can only contain facts from your letter or that you typed. Nothing is invented, no law is cited, and no result is promised. Anything missing becomes a blank for you to fill in.
steps.result: 3 blanks left to fill in: [MEMBER ID], [TODAY'S DATE], [CLINICIAN'S STATEMENT - to be written by your care team].

steps.action: Wrote the summary, document checklist and next steps
steps.why: To explain the letter in simple words and list what to ask your care team for.
steps.result: The AI's wording passed our checks: no verdicts, no legal claims, no numbers that aren't in the letter.
steps.who: The AI wrote it; code checked it

not_checked: Whether the denial is correct. This tool can't judge medical necessity or your plan's rules.
